chapters.caption: Contour plate: chamfer, round notch and a 1 mm wide tab
Layer at z 1 mm: first border (red) and volume hatch (green)
Around the notch the hatch lines end at the border
The 1 mm tab is hatched like the rest of the plate
Fill contours: switch from off to on
The first ring is 0.1 mm inside the border, then every 0.1 mm
After: five orange fill contours inside the border
They follow the notch; the hatch starts 0.6 mm inside
Tab: the rings meet in the middle, no hatch is left
Toolpaths in 3D up to the current layer
